text:
Samir: FYI ran fp8 canary on long-dialog suite; saw low-entropy drift ~2k tokens. dropping logs here.
Tess: repro?
Samir: cmd:
```
rdw canary-run --model redwood-small-fp8 --prompts tests/long_dialog_set.json --seq-len 4096 --seed 123
```
Samir: log snippet:
```
2026-02-14T12:10:03Z token=2034 rolling_entropy=0.29 deg_score=0.78 head7_scale=9.8 kv_overlap=0.62
2026-02-14T12:10:04Z token=2035 top1_prob=0.97 repeated_fragment="..."
```
Ravi: sounds like headwise outliers + KV reuse; global quant scale missed tails.
Tess: runtime mitigations?
Ravi: two paths: cheap detector -> rolling_entropy < 0.5 for 4 tokens -> soft-clamp per-head scales + disable KV reuse for N tokens. Or conservative -> per-request precision-hint header -> route to int8/fp16 tail.
Samir: soft-clamp idea: apply a sigmoid limiter to head_scale when > clip_knee, keep most performance. fallback to full precision if deg_score stays high after 10 tokens.
Tess: need metrics: fp8_tail_incident, clamp_effectiveness, fallback_rate_per_tenant. Also sample head-scale histograms for offline eval.
Ops-Bot: deploy: fp8-canary-softclamp -> 8 hosts, sampling enabled, alerts muted for canary window.
Billing-Bot: note: if conservative fallback used >1% in prod, est cost +18%/mo.
Samir: action items: Ravi -> PR for soft-clamp + feature flag; Tess -> dashboard + sampler; Ops -> 72h canary with sampling. Ticket RDW-5992 opened.
Tess: agree. will add per-tenant budget knobs so customers can opt into safe path for long-form workloads.
Ravi: will include unit tests comparing clamp vs full-precision on held-out set.
Samir: posting results in RDW-5992 after canary. thanks all.
